name: learning-management-system
description: Enterprise-grade Learning Management System (LMS) Monorepo Workspace

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" "npm run dev -w BE_LMS" "npm run dev -w FE_LMS"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n "BE,FE,PRERENDER" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold,yellow.bold" "npm run dev -w BE_LMS" "npm run dev -w FE_LMS" "npm run dev -w prerender-server/prerender-server"
scripts.start: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" "npm run start -w BE_LMS" "npm run preview -w FE_LMS"
